system.description:
At 4th level, your hedge wizard is very capable of distilling remedies, toxins, and occasionally emotions into potions. Anyone using one of your potions can apply it to a weapon or food as a bonus action. Applying a potion to an unwilling target requires you to grapple with, or successfully grab on, your target, but allows you to use an action to force-feed the target on a failed Constitution save. Your hedge wizard may prepare up to three potions during a long rest, and cannot have more than three prepared potions from the following options:

@UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.equipment.Item.1068RTz9y56SWkB3]{Memory}. A creature who consumes a potion of memory must make a Constitution save or be stunned for 1 round. For the next minute all knowledge checks are made with expertise.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.equipment.Item.dT8aaBIcoDIHQnk2]{Restorative}. Consuming a restorative potion restores 2d6 hit points and ends one poison or disease affecting the target. Alternatively it can remove 1 level of Fatigue or Strife and have no other effect.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.9gxmldeg7iu6s4tv]{Venom}. A weapon coated in venom deals an extra 1d6 of poison damage on up to 4 successful melee weapon attacks. If ingested, the imbiber must make a Constitution save or take 4d6 acid damage and become poisoned for 1 hour, even if they are otherwise immune to the poisoned condition.
